project.name: The Classification of Finite Simple Groups
project.description: A Lean 4 formalization of the Classification of Finite Simple Groups, using Tau Ceti's `TauCeti.ClassificationStatement`: every finite simple group is isomorphic to a cyclic group of prime order, an alternating group, a finite simple group of Lie type, or one of the 26 sporadic groups.

main_results.name: CFSG.Milestones.cfsg_classification_native_and_realization
main_results.statement:
theorem cfsg_classification_native_and_realization :
    (∀ (G : Type) [Group G],
      Blueprint.NativeCatalog G ↔ Finite G ∧ Nontrivial G ∧ IsSimpleGroup G) ∧
    (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime →
      Finite (Multiplicative (ZMod p)) ∧ Nontrivial (Multiplicative (ZMod p)) ∧
        IsSimpleGroup (Multiplicative (ZMod p))) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, 5 ≤ n →
      Finite (alternatingGroup (Fin n)) ∧ Nontrivial (alternatingGroup (Fin n)) ∧
        IsSimpleGroup (alternatingGroup (Fin n))) ∧
    (∀ (t : Assembly.LowTwoRank.StatedLieTag) (n p f : ℕ),
      Assembly.LowTwoRank.StatedLieAdmissible t n p f →
      ∃ (H : Type) (_ : Group H), Finite H ∧ Nontrivial H ∧ IsSimpleGroup H ∧
        Blueprint.LieModel H t n p f) ∧
    (∀ s : TauCeti.SporadicName, Finite (nativeCarrier s) ∧ Nontrivial (nativeCarrier s) ∧
      IsSimpleGroup (nativeCarrier s))

readme: A sorry-free Lean4 (v4.35.0-rc3) proof of the Classification of Finite Simple Groups (CFSG), built on Mathlib and TauCeti, using the standard axioms `Classical.choice`, `propext`, and `Quot.sound` (no `native_decide`). We primarily follow the first generation proof of CFSG.

We use the [statement of CFSG from the TauCeti project](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/6e0c6acab5f4c6f42e5f5bab9bd5e4e84f74c380/TauCeti/GroupTheory/SpecificGroups/CFSG/Classification.lean#L52-L56)

```lean4
/-- **Classification of finite simple groups, statement only.** Every finite simple group is
isomorphic to one of the explicitly constructed groups on the classification list. -/
def ClassificationStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (G : Type u) [Group G] [Finite G] [IsSimpleGroup G],
    ∃ i : CFSGIndex, Nonempty (G ≃* i.Group)
```
